acceptanceCriteria.text: A Class facet renders its TS METHOD SIGNATURES (visibility name(params):returnType) — the data exists from R36.3 part-1 enrichment.

Empty vs absent DISTINGUISHED with teeth: a genuinely empty class shows '(no members)'; when fetchModel returns NULL (members unavailable) it shows '⚠ members unavailable' — because node-build currently SWALLOWS the null (if(!mm)continue) and a swallowed error is indistinguishable from success. Fail-visible, never a silent empty box.
Renders via the SINGLE renderFacet/deriveViewKind path — NO rival renderer or type-map (the family single-source, ties R40.23/BUG-D).
